insight: Acquired by TransPerfect in Aug 2025; its TowerLLM and open-source COMET metric are being folded into the GlobalLink stack.
name: Unbabel
tagline: Enterprise LangOps platform pairing TowerLLM machine translation with human review.
description: A Lisbon-born enterprise translation platform that pioneered the hybrid machine-plus-human-editor model for multilingual customer support and content. Built TowerLLM, a translation-purpose-built LLM, and authored COMET, the open-source quality metric much of the MT industry benchmarks with — so quality estimation is native to the workflow. Acquired by TransPerfect in 2025, it continues as a brand and business unit with its models feeding the GlobalLink portfolio.

modelSupport.notes: In-house TowerLLM purpose-built for translation; quality tooling also benchmarks and routes third-party MT engines.

edge: Owns both a translation-native LLM (TowerLLM) and COMET, the open metric the MT industry benchmarks with — rare end-to-end control.
pros: Authored COMET, the standard MT quality metric
Human-in-the-loop review option for high stakes
cons: No public pricing; sales-led enterprise motion
Widn.AI product line being folded into GlobalLink
